bookkeeping.rowText: Astra, 22 minutes, three maps, two honest attempts each, zero errors on every row. Blackout Ridge PARTIAL again (wave 12 secured, banked, reloaded; the storage goal fails under nearest-first and west-to-east repairs, both banks 0 Wh, F-PP2-1). The Canyon Works FAIL on both projects: every approach to the gallery stops at z about -7.88; the finding derives the wall from the contract's creekHeight 0.5, railHeight -1, blend -8 to -6 and the tile-height slope (1.03 at z -7), a contract or simulation defect a walking player cannot pass, the CONNECT deadline unwinnable (F-PP2-2, HIGH: a corrective task follows). The Fairground FAIL: the wheel destroyed at wave 2 or wave 1 under two fort openings (F-PP2-3, a hold). The Incline proof re-run against the grown driver: green both projects. Engine hash unchanged {PIN}; no deploy. Run 3 carries the remaining list from the Dust Flats onward.
